executedQuery:
_sourceCategory=formstack/prod/*
| json field=_raw "context.event" as event
| json field=_raw "context.authProviderId" as authProviderId
| json field=_raw "context.accountId" as accountId
| json field=_raw "context.formId" as formId
| json field=_raw "context.redirectUrlPath" as redirectUrlPath
| json field=_raw "context.formAlias" as formAlias
| json field=_raw "context.sessionId" as sessionId
| json field=_raw "context.errorId" as errorId
| json field=_raw "extra.url" as url
| json field=_raw "extra.referrer" as referrer
| where event = "auth_provider_saml" AND authProviderId = 2175

recordSchema._validationNote: To validate results, run the executedQuery directly in Sumo Logic
